q: What does a BEE star rating on an induction motor mean?
title: BEE star rating for induction motors
short: BEE rates three phase induction motors from 1 star (IE2) to 5 star (IE3++, equivalent to IE4) by full-load efficiency. A 7.5 kW, 4 pole motor needs 88.7 percent for 1 star, 90.4 for 3 stars and 92.6 for 5 stars. Labelling is voluntary.
audience: Maintenance heads and motor buyers in factories

ul: 5 star: IE3(++), which BEE equates to IE4 values.

p: Schedule 6 covers 2, 4 and 6 pole squirrel cage motors for continuous duty, as per IS 12615:2011, from 0.37 kW to 375 kW. IE2 is the entry level for a label. There is no tolerance on the star band: the motors tested must meet the threshold.

ol: Find your motor's rating and poles in the schedule table.
Compare the efficiency at each star level.
Weigh the price difference against running hours, as in the IE2 to IE4 replacement page.
